data_card.measured: Steady exchange discharge, surface depth and pipe head for 36 conditions in four scenarios (S1 surface-to-sewer without surcharge, S2 surface-to-sewer with the pipe surcharged, S3 and S4 sewer-to-surface), in the University of Sheffield facility linking an 8 m x 4 m floodplain to a pipe network through a 0.24 m manhole (Rubinato et al. 2017, Table 2).
data_card.method: Electromagnetic flowmeters checked against volumetric tank readings; pressure transducers 0.35 m (sewer) and 0.46 m (surface) from the manhole centre.
data_card.uncertainty: Transducer calibration error 0.109 mm (surface) and 0.72 mm (sewer). No numeric flowmeter accuracy is given; the paper's nf column gives the variation of the exchange flow.
known_issues: Rows marked '–' in the paper are blank here: S1 has no pipe head, S4 no surface depth (dry floodplain).
The surcharge percentage for S2 is negative in the transcription (surface-to-sewer flow); the sign follows the HydroCouple transcription.
data_card.exercises: Water leaving a surcharged sewer through a manhole onto a surface and spreading: the exchange flow and the head loss at the manhole.
data_card.cannot_tell: The exchange coefficient is partly a calibration choice; a match shows the coupling can be tuned to the rig, not that it transfers to other manhole geometries.

title: Rubinato manhole exchange
description: Laboratory sewer/surface exchange through a manhole; validate 1D–2D coupling exchange equations (Rubinato et al. 2017).

provenance.adaptation_notes: Reference: Table 2 (36 steady exchange measurements, scenarios S1-S4) and the rig geometry (section 3.1, Figs 1-2) of Rubinato et al. (2017), an open-access article under CC BY 4.0. Transcribed by the HydroCouple OpenSWMM benchmarks project (corpus/rubinato-2017, commit 3f490b5, public domain); spot-checked here against the published table. The CoUDlabs dataset (Zenodo 10683906, CC BY 4.0) from the same facility adds raw series. Still to build: the rig model inputs (mesh, inflows, outfall stage).

pending.reason: Build the rig model from reference/rig_geometry.yaml: 8 m x 4 m floodplain at slope 0.001 and n 0.009, 0.24 m manhole, 0.075 m pipe; one steady run per Table 2 row.

uncertainty.notes: Transducer calibration error from the paper: 0.109 mm for the surface transducer and 0.72 mm for the sewer transducer (the larger is used here). Discharge accuracy is not given numerically; the nf column (eq. 6) is the paper's exchange-flow variation and bounds the exchange discharge.

criteria.rationale: Median relative error in steady exchange discharge over the 36 rows of Table 2, within 10 %. Written before any run; the paper's own exchange-flow variation (nf) is a few percent of Qe.
Surface depth hs at the transducer within 1 mm for the surface-flow scenarios; reported, not counted, until a model reports depth at the transducer position.
